findings.title: Login predicate NPEs when IdP config map is null
findings.body: File server-spi/src/main/java/org/keycloak/models/IdentityProviderStorageProvider.java line 254 does idp.getConfig().get(OrganizationModel.BROKER_PUBLIC) without null-checking getConfig(). If an IdentityProviderModel has a null config map, getLoginPredicate().test(idp) throws NullPointerException. The predicate is called on every create/remove/update in InfinispanIdentityProviderStorageProvider to decide login-cache invalidation, so a single IdP with null config breaks those write paths. Use null-safe access like getConfig() != null and getOrDefault.

findings.title: Update uses organization-aware wrapper for invalidation decision
findings.body: File model/infinispan/src/main/java/org/keycloak/models/cache/infinispan/idp/InfinispanIdentityProviderStorageProvider.java line 91 fetches original via getById() which returns an organization-aware wrapper whose isEnabled() returns false when the linked organization is disabled. That wrapper is then passed to registerIDPLoginInvalidationOnUpdate which evaluates LoginFilter.getLoginPredicate() using isEnabled(). When the org is disabled the original incorrectly evaluates as non-login, so an update that changes real login status (e.g. disabling the IdP) looks like false->false and skips invalidation. After the org is re-enabled the getForLogin cache still contains the stale IdP id. Fetch the raw delegate model for the predicate comparison instead of the wrapped model.

findings.title: Test cleanup removes literal alias instead of created IdPs
findings.body: File testsuite/integration-arquillian/tests/base/src/test/java/org/keycloak/testsuite/organization/cache/OrganizationCacheTest.java line 303 (repeated at lines 381 and 425) does getCleanup().addCleanup(testRealm().identityProviders().get("alias")::remove) with the literal string "alias" instead of the alias just created (org-idp-i / idp-alias-i / idp-alias-20). The cleanup therefore never removes the 20+10 IdPs created by testCacheIDPByOrg and testCacheIDPForLogin, leaving realm state polluted for subsequent tests and masking cache-isolation assertions.
